mapInfo: July's schedule: 10th and 11th - Seminar: Integrating contemplative practices in daily activities; 16th-18th - weekend retreat; 23rd- August 1st - 10 days silent retreat.

Obs: To keep our place quiet and silent, we ask you to park your motorized vehicle in the parking lot at the entrance of the riverwalk. For those who cannot come walking, please let us know. We also strongly suggest, specially for those taking the 10 days retreat, to join our lift arregement. Please call 222-PEACE
